question: Should external.connection.desktop.passwordEnv be accepted only from trusted/source-bound configuration before generic external macOS desktop support can merge?
rationale: The PR adds a new path from configuration to inherited environment secrets and then to WebVNC credentials, which is a security-boundary choice rather than ordinary feature plumbing.

options.title: Require source-bound desktop credentials
options.body: Extend the External credential-boundary model to desktop.passwordEnv and only read the selected environment variable after trusted user config, flag, environment, or validated routing approval.

options.title: Accept repository-selected passwordEnv
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly allow repository config to choose the desktop password environment variable, but that weakens the boundary PR 972 is trying to establish.

options.title: Pause the desktop feature
options.body: Leave generic external macOS desktop support closed until the External credential-boundary direction has landed and been proven.

recommendation.title: Require source-bound desktop credentials
recommendation.body: Extend the External credential-boundary model to desktop.passwordEnv and only read the selected environment variable after trusted user config, flag, environment, or validated routing approval.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the adjacent External SSH credential-boundary PR that this desktop credential surface must align with.
